title: Sections over the complement of V(I) and maps from powers of I (quasi-compact scheme)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of finite type [pqf-def-coherent] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\mathcal I^0=\mathcal O_X$ and, for $n\ge1$, let $\mathcal I^n$ be the powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk] ($\mathcal I^1=\mathcal I$, $\mathcal I^{n+1}=\mathcal I\cdot\mathcal I^n$, the image of the multiplication map $\mathcal I\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal I^n\to\mathcal O_X$), so that $\mathcal I^{n+1}\subseteq\mathcal I^n$. Regard each stalk $\mathcal I_x$ as an ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk](1), put $V(\mathcal I)=\{x\in X:\mathcal I_x\neq\mathcal O_{X,x}\}$ and $U=X\setminus V(\mathcal I)$. Then $\mathcal I^n(W)=\mathcal O_X(W)$ for every open $W\subseteq U$ and every $n\ge0$; for an $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\varphi:\mathcal I^n\to\mathcal M$ into an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal M$ write $\varphi_U(1)\in\mathcal M(U)$ for the image of $1\in\mathcal I^n(U)=\mathcal O_X(U)$. (1) The maps $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n,\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal F)$, $\varphi\mapsto\varphi_U(1)$, are compatible with the restriction maps $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^{n+1},\mathcal F)$ along $\mathcal I^{n+1}\subseteq\mathcal I^n$, and the induced map $\varinjlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n,\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal F)$ (colimit over $n\ge0$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]) is injective. (2) Assume moreover that $X$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $n\ge0$ let $\mathcal F_n\subseteq\mathcal F$ be the subsheaf of sections annihilated by $\mathcal I^n$: $\mathcal F_n(W)=\{s\in\mathcal F(W): a\,s|_{W'}=0$ for every open $W'\subseteq W$ and every $a\in\mathcal I^n(W')\}$; it is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module with $\mathcal F_n\subseteq\mathcal F_{n+1}$ and $\mathcal F_n(W)=0$ for $W\subseteq U$ open, so the quotient map $q_n:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal F_n$ (cokernel of the inclusion) induces an isomorphism $\mathcal F|_U\cong(\mathcal F/\mathcal F_n)|_U$, through which $\Gamma(U,\mathcal F/\mathcal F_n)$ is identified with $\Gamma(U,\mathcal F)$. Then the maps $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n,\mathcal F/\mathcal F_n)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal F)$, $\varphi\mapsto\varphi_U(1)$, are compatible with the transition maps $\varphi\mapsto\bar q\circ\varphi|_{\mathcal I^{n+1}}$ ($\bar q:\mathcal F/\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal F/\mathcal F_{n+1}$ induced by $\mathcal F_n\subseteq\mathcal F_{n+1}$), and the induced map $\varinjlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n,\mathcal F/\mathcal F_n)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal F)$ is bijective.
